# Templates

| Template | Use for |
|----------|---------|
| adr-template.md | any architecture or vendor decision |
| process-l2-template.md | L2 process description (framework Stage 2) |
| runbook-template.md | manual / hybrid process instruction (Stage 3) |
| interface-spec-template.md | port, event, adapter, API, player or regulator format |
| assistant-instructions-template.md | a tandem's AI assistant instructions |

Copy, rename, fill the front matter, open a PR.
